data.subject: Re: PO-4821 Delivery Update
data.content: Hi, we apologize for the delay in PO-4821. Raw material shortage from our sub-supplier caused 7 days delay. The shipment has now been dispatched. To avoid this in the future, we are increasing our buffer stock of critical materials. Regards, Rajesh

data.subject: New Supplier Onboarding - Documentation
data.content: Hi Rajesh, as part of your onboarding, please share your latest ISO certificate, GST registration, and ESG/sustainability report for review. Regards, Procurement Team
